questions.question: What license do most drivers of ordinary passenger cars need?

questions.explanation: Boarding a domestic flight. Refer to Section 1 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.question: When entering a highway, which traffic has the right-of-way?

questions.explanation: Three seconds. Refer to Section 6 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.explanation: Three feet. Refer to Section 8 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.explanation: No more than 200 feet. Refer to Section 8 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.explanation: At least 15 feet away. Refer to Section 6 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.explanation: 0.01% or higher. Refer to Section 9 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.

questions.explanation: 0.04%. Refer to Section 9 of the 2025 California Driver’s Handbook.
